content: Core feature set across MyFitnessPal, MacroFactor, Cronometer, YAZIO, FatSecret, Lose It: food search logging, barcode scan, daily macro dashboard with remaining balance, configurable macro targets, weight tracking, custom foods, progress photos, body measurements. Quality of food database (verified vs user-submitted) and logging speed are the main competitive axes. MacroFactor official comparison claims MyFitnessPal needs about 1.5x more discrete actions to log the same foods.
